title: Runtime, embedding, shell, performance and tooling completion
objective: Implement the five follow-up stages requested by the user, with explicit capabilities and reproducible documentation.
acceptance: Verify all register operands and control flow, definite initialization, function references and handler/iteration scopes.
Track structural collection changes independently of length and remove permissive Wasm type checks.
Expose register budgets and diagnostic boundaries to embedding clients and support canonical execution for the language surface.
Persist shell definitions, support multiline input and history, and provide atomic module replacement.
Measure representative execution paths and record optimizations with raw measurements.
Provide developer commands, distribution automation and a complete Portuguese usage/reimplementation guide.
Publish commits and a draft PR, disclosing skipped tests and remaining limitations.
constraints: Do not execute tests: explicit user instruction.
No invented syntax or language semantics outside canon.
No fabricated Prumo approvals, test results or performance measurements.
No merging or public release publication.
